translations.web: As the cloud is consumed and vanishes away, so he who goes down to Sheol will come up no more.
translations.bsb: As a cloud vanishes and is gone, so he who goes down to Sheol does not come back up.
translations.kjv: As the cloud is consumed and vanisheth away: so he that goeth down to the grave shall come up
translations.asv: As the cloud is consumed and vanisheth away, So he that goeth down to Sheol shall come up no more.
